title: History 1702 full eligible diff: Bug 1921394 - Change FolderCollector to use folder names instead of filenames. r=mkmelin This is going to make it easier to find an nsIFolder's corresponding nsIMsgFolder, because we'll be able to use GetChildNamed and the nsIFolder's name. It also means we have proper folders names in cases where the file name is a hash (e.g. when forbidden characters are involved).
